question: Among never-served loop-forming world edges that formed by cycle 90 and were not asserted during their first 20 loop cycles, does early retention measured over that full 20-cycle window predict assertion by cycle 120, including for edges that formed after cycle 60?
scope: Twelve fresh seeds, 120 cycles, cap 40, compositional world; per-edge 20-cycle predictor window from formation through formation + 19; formation ceiling 90.

design.world: generate_compositional_world(seed=, cycles=120) with the PHASE_ACQUISITION schedule and one replay per seed
design.population: never-served world edges with ever_loop=true, formation_cycle <= 90, and no assertion at or before formation_cycle + 19
design.excluded: never-served edges that never loop; edges that form after cycle 90; edges asserted during their first 20 loop cycles
design.window: the 20 cycles formation_cycle through formation_cycle + 19, inclusive; the landmark is formation_cycle + 19
design.outcome: asserted in the final structure at cycle 120, with at least one outcome cycle after the landmark
design.outcome_horizon: formation_cycle + 20 through 120; this varies by formation, so followup_cycles/120 is a control and no edge has fewer than 10 outcome cycles
design.freshness: New seed block 20619101-20619112.  The collision scan over docs JSON is empty at freeze time; the prior block's seeds and rows are excluded.

primary_predictors.early_retention: distinct loop cycles in the 20-cycle window divided by 20; range [0, 1], with a full window for every eligible edge
primary_predictors.rank20: minimum 1-based position in the repaired observer's full pre-cap universe over the 20-cycle window
primary_predictors.count20: direct temporal transition count at the landmark
primary_predictors.strength20: maximum loop_candidate strength over reported loops in the 20-cycle window
primary_predictors.formation_descriptive: first loop cycle divided by 120; reported but not a fitted predictor
primary_predictors.followup: number of cycles from formation + 20 through 120, divided by 120; the single fitted horizon control

design.late_cohort: eligible edges with formation_cycle > 60.  The model reports a separate late-cohort estimate, but the verdict is the frozen all-cohort primary plus the late-representation gate.

reverse_time.late_retention: distinct loop cycles from formation + 20 through 120, divided by the available outcome cycles
reverse_time.assertion_cycle: first cycle the edge appears in structure_edges after the landmark; required for every asserted edge and must be greater than formation_cycle + 19
reverse_time.purpose: If post-landmark retention carries the same association as the first-20-cycle predictor, the result is concurrent or reverse-time, not evidence that early retention precedes assertion.

model.primary_formula: logit P(asserted by 120) = b0 + b_rank*z(log2(rank20)) + b_count*z(count20) + b_strength*z(strength20) + b_followup*z(followup) + b_early*z(early_retention) + seed fixed effects
model.reverse_formula: same controls, with late_retention replacing early_retention
model.identification: `formation` and `followup` are exact affine transforms: `followup = (101 - formation) / 120`.  The fitted model uses `followup` as the single horizon control; `formation_cycle` is descriptive and has no separate coefficient.  This amendment was recorded before any grant or seed replay.
model.seed: twelve-level fixed effect, first seed as reference

model_note: `formation` and `followup` are exact affine transforms: `followup = (101 - formation) / 120`.  The fitted model uses `followup` as the single horizon control; `formation_cycle` is descriptive and has no separate coefficient.  This amendment was recorded before any grant or seed replay.

criteria.name: gates
criteria.test: all confirmatory gates pass, including late representation

criteria.name: reverse-time diagnostic
criteria.test: late-retention OR <= 1 or its 95% CI includes 1

gates.M1_population: at least 60 eligible edges and 20 asserted events; one row per seed-edge
gates.M2_window_complete: every eligible row formed by 90, has no assertion at or before its landmark, and has finite early_retention in a full 20-cycle window
gates.M3_rank_coverage: at least 95% of eligible edges have a finite rank20
gates.M5_convergence: both the primary and reverse Firth fits converge with finite coefficients
gates.M6_complete: every fitted row has finite count20, strength20 and followup
gates.M7_reverse_onset: every asserted eligible row has a finite assertion_cycle after its landmark; every non-asserted eligible row has no assertion_cycle
gates.M8_no_collision: the seed block is collision-free at freeze and check
gates.M9_late_representation: at least 10 eligible edges and 3 asserted events have formation_cycle > 60; otherwise the late-forming claim is VOID

not_evidence: An observational formation-anchored landmark model on one synthetic world family.  Early and post-landmark retention both carry positive associations, so this block does not establish that early retention precedes assertion.  It does not establish a mechanism, capability, transfer, causal effect, or general engine property.
